appearance_facts.fact: A blue line with circular markers descends from the top-left toward the bottom-right, forming a convex curve that steepens in the final third of the x-axis.
A light-blue/purple shaded area fills the region between the descending line and the top edge of the plot, visually emphasizing the magnitude of the drop.
The first data point sits near the top of the y-axis (close to 0 on the inverted scale), indicating a low initial count.
The final data point is the lowest on the page, positioned near the 8000 tick on the inverted y-axis, indicating the highest count in the series.
The slope of the line becomes noticeably steeper after the 'Mar 7, 2020' marker, showing an accelerating rate of change in the later dates.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads: 'Month vs. Number of COVID-19 patients hospitalized'.

X-axis tick labels run chronologically from 'Feb 24, 2020' on the left to 'Mar 14, 2020' on the right.
The final data point aligns with the 'Mar 14, 2020' tick and is positioned vertically just below the '8000' tick mark.
The initial data point aligns with the 'Feb 24, 2020' tick and is positioned vertically just below the '0' tick mark.
